choices: forEach is not a valid Stream method
A stream cannot be reused after a terminal operation has been called on it
List.of() returns an immutable list that cannot be streamed
System.out::println requires a Consumer, not a method reference
explanation: Streams are single-use. Once a terminal operation (forEach) is called, the stream is consumed. Calling any operation on it again throws IllegalStateException. Create a new stream from the collection each time.
